description:
Big adventures start with little wheels! Introducing the Lynskey Children's Tricycle, a thoughtfully designed first ride that brings together childhood adventure, confidence, and the quality of genuine titanium craftsmanship.

Hand-built in Chattanooga, Tennessee, our Lynskey Tricycle is designed to make those early riding experiences even more special. Its three-wheel design provides a stable platform for little riders as they develop coordination, balance, and confidence while discovering the joy of riding on their own.

Built with our signature titanium construction, this is no ordinary children's tricycle. Lightweight, incredibly durable, and naturally corrosion-resistant, titanium delivers a premium riding experience with the kind of lasting quality that can be enjoyed for years to come.

From the first push of the pedals to countless backyard adventures, the Lynskey Children's Tricycle is more than just a first bike. It's an introduction to a lifetime of riding.
